lines.t: Good morning, friends! I am Rayo! Today I visit the big railway station!
Look, the ticket window! One little ticket for me, please!
The long platform is so busy! I zoom to my spot! Vroom!
Here comes the big red steam train! Choo choo!
Bye bye, kind conductor! See you at the next station!
Into the dark tunnel! My headlights shine so bright!
The signal light turned green! Go go go!
Over the tall bridge we go, above the blue river!
Wow, the cargo yard! So many colorful boxes!
The little mail car carries letters for everyone!
Snack time! A warm bun from the platform cart!
Two trains wave hello! Toot toot, goodbye!
The waiting room is warm and cozy with big chairs!
From the lookout, what a wonderful view of the trains!
The sun is setting! Golden light on the shiny tracks!
Night is here! The lamps glow like little stars!
Wow, the big engine shed! The sleepy engines rest inside!
Hot, sweet chai from the little stall! Sip sip, so yummy!
The fluffy station cat is chasing butterflies! Come back, little friend!
The tall water tower fills the thirsty train! Glug glug glug!
Ding ding! The crossing gate comes down! Stop, wait, and smile!
Up the footbridge I climb! I can see the whole station!
Tick tock! The big clock in the clock room tells the time!
The parcel van is full of gifts! Maybe one is for me!
Shhh! The sleeper coach has soft, cozy beds!
In the goods yard, big cranes lift the heavy boxes high!
The ticket hall is bright and happy! Everyone is smiling!
Here comes the last train of the day! All aboard! Choo choo!
The sleepy train cars yawn, good night!
What a fun day! Bye bye, railway station! Vroom vroom!
Good morning, friends! I am Bella! Today I visit the big flower market!
Vroom vroom! Down the petal path I roll, toward the flower fields!
Wow, the tall sunflowers are smiling at me! Hello, hello!
The tulip rows are red and yellow, just like my paint!
The kind gardener fills my baskets with sweet roses!
Look! The market gate wears a crown of marigold garlands!
Inside, the stalls burst with every color! What a happy place!
Sweet jasmine flowers! Oh, how lovely they smell!
The tulip lady waves at me! One big basket, please!
Daisies, daisies! White like little clouds!
I deliver fresh flowers to the bakery auntie! Mmm, warm cake!
The fountain square sparkles with pigeons and petals!
Up the green hill I climb, past the old windmill!
The rainbow bridge sways above the blue river!
Flowers for the school kids! Look at those happy smiles!
The old clock tower rings! Ding dong, ding dong!
I rest under the big mango tree, breathing sweet air!
Butterflies dance around my mirrors! Whee, so pretty!
The flower parade float is so grand! Follow me, friends!
Petals fall like rain! What a lovely flower shower!
I carry garlands up the old temple steps!
Evening falls, and the lantern lane glows golden!
The boatman floats my flowers down the calm canal!
Fireflies light my way home! Twinkle, twinkle!
One last stop: fresh flowers for my best friend Rayo!
The moon rises over the sleepy village! So quiet, so calm!
Home at last! My garage smells of sweet flowers!
I dream of fields and colors and happy faces!
Good night, flowers! Good night, friends!
See you at the market tomorrow! Bye bye!
